name: wordlens
description: WordLens — a Chrome extension that appends your own Chinese glosses to English words on any page. Local-only, no AI, no server.

scripts.dev: npm run build:content -- --watch & npm run build:popup -- --watch & wait
scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build:popup
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
